window_turn: Took the lock at 14:09 and released it about 4 minutes later. The cold window showed only 'Thursday 12 November', 'Start on Midterm 2 / Intro Statistics' with a Return cap, an empty line and 'Your other courses: ⌘O'. Nothing about what I owe. I pressed Return on the empty line and was in a lesson at once: the plan was in the right margin and the cursor was in the exercise. I clicked Hint and got a hint, with the question printed again below it. Then I typed 'by the way, what is a p-value actually?' where the cursor was (the exercise line, not the talk line). The tutor answered off-plan, the gutter said 'no mark', and nothing looked like I was behind. I typed 'ugh I skipped like three days, can you change the plan' (again in the exercise line). The agenda changed in place: Sun 29 Nov, 'Moved from Sun 22 Nov', 'moved up' and 'moved down', and a timed green 'The plan changed.' line on the page. 'b = 5' got 'not right / with a hint' in grey in the margin and a gentle 'Try it once more', which didn't feel like a punishment. A second answer got no mark. ⌘E asked 'Where did you stop? One line for next time.' with the line already filled in. Return ended the sitting, and the page offered 'Pick up where you stopped today' with Return again. Scrolling up after ending, the 'not right' mark had moved onto my hint request and the 'no mark' labels were gone. Typing latency measured 17 ms median, 19 ms p95. Startup was 827 ms.
